content.description: SyncSwap is the definitive decentralized exchange and liquidity hub built natively for the zkSync Era ecosystem, designed to provide a seamless trading experience. The platform utilizes a unique multi-pool architecture that supports various pricing models—including Classic, Stable, and Concentrated Liquidity—to ensure maximum capital efficiency. Leveraging advanced zero-knowledge technology, SyncSwap provides a professional-grade environment that prioritizes user sovereignty. The protocol is designed for high scalability, having expanded its services to other major rollups like Linea.
